resources.string: Keep track of the family\'s appointments, commitments and recurring dates. Every event has a category and a colour, so you can see at a glance whose day is packed.
Keep reports, contracts, certificates and receipts in one place, organised into folders. Files are end-to-end encrypted: only your family can open them.
Track what goes out and what for, broken down by category. See how the month is going and who paid for what.
Add whatever you\'ve run out of and tick it off while you\'re at the shop. The list is shared: if someone grabs the milk, you\'ll see it disappear from your phone.
Keep a record of appliances, warranties and maintenance, and stay on top of recurring bills like rent, utilities and service charges.
Store the household\'s credentials and share them only with the people you choose. Everything is end-to-end encrypted, and KidBox can fill them in for you in apps and on the web.
Add the dogs, cats and everyone else in the house: health record, vaccines, treatments and vet visits, always within reach.
Gather the family\'s photos and videos into shared albums, without handing them to a social network. Everything is end-to-end encrypted and stays between you.
Add cars, motorbikes and bikes: insurance, inspection, road tax and servicing at a glance, with a reminder before every deadline.
Save travel, concert and cinema tickets: they\'re here even offline, with a reminder before you set off. All end-to-end encrypted.
ID cards, driving licences, health cards and passports for the whole family, always with you. End-to-end encrypted, with a warning before they expire.
Collect your shop loyalty cards and show the barcode at the till, without carrying your wallet around. Card photos are end-to-end encrypted.
